info.scriptSrcText: property this, Xpos, radians, Ypos, mapXPos, raftFront, cableGuy, swellList, swellListPointer, crumpus, crumpusX, crumpusPointer, COPTER, loopX, loopWidthglobal gXVel, gXOffset, gPaused, gTileIDListon beginSprite  radians = float(PI / 180)  this = sprite(the currentSpriteNum)  cableGuy = sprite(6)  crumpus = sprite(the currentSpriteNum + 8)  COPTER = sprite(4)  loopX = gTileIDList.count * 128 * 0.5  loopWidth = gTileIDList.count * 128  Xpos = float(this.locH)  Ypos = float(this.locV)  this.locZ = 50  mapXPos = Xpos - 256  swellAngle = random(360)  swellList = []  swellListPointer = random(90)  repeat with i = 1 to 180    swellAngle = i * 2    swellList.add(15 * cos(swellAngle * radians))  end repeat  crumpusPointer = 1.0  crumpus.locZ = 49  crumpusX = -100  crumpus.locH = this.locH  crumpus.locV = this.locVendon exitFrame  if gPaused = 0 then    Xpos = Xpos + gXVel + gXOffset    if Xpos > loopX then      Xpos = Xpos - loopWidth    end if    if Xpos < -loopX then      Xpos = Xpos + loopWidth    end if    this.locH = Xpos    swellListPointer = swellListPointer + 2    if swellListPointer > 180 then      swellListPointer = 1    end if    this.locV = Ypos + swellList[swellListPointer]    crumpus.locH = this.locH + crumpusX    crumpusX = crumpusX + 2    if crumpusX = -90 then      if (this.locH > 0) and (this.locH < 512) then        puppetSound(2, member(32, "Sfx"))      end if    end if    crumpusPointer = crumpusPointer + 1    if crumpusPointer > 180 then      crumpusPointer = 1    end if    temp = swellList[crumpusPointer] * 12    if temp < 1 then      temp = 1      crumpusX = -100    end if    crumpus.height = temp  end if  yDiff = this.locV - COPTER.locV  if yDiff < crumpus.height then    xDiff = this.locH - COPTER.locH    if abs(xDiff) < 100 then      COPTER.Yvel = COPTER.Yvel - 0.10000000000000001      COPTER.tiltAngle = COPTER.tiltAngle + 0.5    end if  end ifend
